dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the local government of Paducah, Kentucky, the Department of the Interior, and the Oscar Cross Boys & Girls Club.
dimensions.evidence: the City of Paducah, Kentucky, not transfer or sell the parcel of land to any other entity, except the Oscar Cross Boys & Girls Club of Paducah

dimensions.assessment: Lifts legal restrictions on a single 3.62-acre property to allow compatible public, recreational, or specific organizational use.
dimensions.evidence: remove all deed restrictions from the parcel of land described in subsection (d)

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue changes are stated or implied.
Applies strictly to one defined parcel of land via administrative action by the Secretary of the Interior.
dimensions.evidence: comprised of approximately 3.62 acres located at 2956 Park Avenue, on the Paducah Memorial Army Reserve Center

dimensions.assessment: Provides a permanent removal of restrictions subject to enduring conditions on property conveyance and use.
dimensions.evidence: Secretary shall execute such instruments as may be necessary to remove all deed restrictions

missing_information: Financial valuation of the land parcel
Economic impact of removing the deed restrictions
importance_detail.rationale: The bill removes deed restrictions from a specific 3.62-acre parcel of land in Paducah, Kentucky, applying conditions on its future transfer and use.
